name: FontsWiki · Cabin Font Family

description.zh: 先比较左侧样张，再读右侧未核许可提示与下载步骤。 可按类别查找字形、比较预览并进入单款详情的字体资源入口，另有字体替代与应用参考栏目。本次查看 Cabin 样张和下载流程，页面明说许可尚未独立核实；第二阶段下载页需等待签名链接解锁，字体文件及原作者适用许可尚未取得，商业使用范围未确认。
description.en: A font resource with category browsing, preview comparison, and detail pages, alongside typeface alternatives and usage references. We examined the Cabin specimen and download flow. The page states licensing has not been independently verified, and the second download page awaits a signed link to unlock. The font file and original designer’s license were not obtained, so commercial permissions remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by FontsWiki (https://fontswiki.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 先比较左侧样张，再读右侧未核许可提示与下载步骤。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页进入 Categories，先看到粗体、手写、装饰和窄体等分类，再开 Cabin 看具体样张。建议把左侧字形与自己要排的文字对照，再读右侧许可提示；这里明确说许可尚未独立核实。下载还要进入签名链接解锁页，本次只取得该页说明，没有拿到字体包；选中后应继续核原作者许可和实际文件，不凭字体名确认商用。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
